data.name: Khuzaim
data.gender_notes: Khuzaim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A man who gathers wealth, knowledge or people. Derived from the name of Prophet Khizar (Khezr) in Islamic tradition. The name Khuzaim carries the meaning “Gatherer” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Khuzaim usually hope their child will grow to embody gatherer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a man who is a gatherer of knowledge, wealth, and people. It is derived from the name of Prophet Khizar (Khezr), who was known for his immense knowledge, wisdom, and generosity.
data.etymology: Khuzaim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gatherer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khuzaim total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Khuzaim holds a rich cultural significance, as it is derived from the name of Prophet Khidr (Khezr) in Islamic tradition. Prophet Khidr is one of the most revered figures in Islam, known for his profound wisdom and unparalleled knowledge. He is often considered a patron of travelers, scholars, healers, and those seeking spiritual guidance.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Khuzaim also holds deep spiritual significance for Muslims, reminding them of the importance of gathering knowledge, wisdom, and good deeds. The name derives from the Arabic root "kh-z-m," which means "to gather," emphasizing the idea of accumulating positive qualities and experiences throughout one's life.
